# Nico Verdejo

> Nico Verdejo (Nicolás Verdejo Bravo) is a Chilean architectural designer, historian, and illustrator. He researches, writes, and draws stories where architecture, politics, and affects intersect.

- PhD in Architecture, Penn State (Fulbright, 2026); Magíster, Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile (2017); Architect, Pontificia Universidad Católica de Valparaíso (2013).
- Research: architecture schools in Chile under the Pinochet dictatorship (1973–1990). Graham Foundation Citation of Special Recognition (2024). Author of the book "Cambiar de vida".
- Illustration: graphic novels (The Black Cats, The Funambulist), urban sketches, political and personal drawing series.
- Contact: nverdejob@gmail.com · Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nicoverdejo/
